displayIdentity.body: A painful visit and tearful letter are delayed. But I determined this for myself, that I would not come to you again in sorrow. For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote to you with many tears, not that you should be made to grieve, but that you might know the love that I have so abundantly for you.
